label: Gödel's 1970 theorem Th1: at every world, being GOD_LIKE_6 is an ESSENCE_1, in…, by Case-analysis
meaning: AFP Th1 (Ax2a Ax2b Essence_def God_def). Let x be God-like and have ψ. By Ax2a ψ or its negation is positive. Not its negation, since x would then lack ψ. So ψ is positive, hence necessarily positive (Ax2b), and at every accessible world every God-like individual has ψ. Ax2a supplies the disjunction, so no excluded middle is needed.
